description: This file defines search fields for the 'Cases' module in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM project. It specifies various search criteria, including filters for status, priority, date ranges, user-specific filters, and favorites, with some fields supporting range and date filtering.
calls: SELECT favorites.parent_id FROM favorites WHERE favorites.deleted = 0 and favorites.parent_type = 'Cases' and favorites.assigned_user_id = '{1}'
